## Goal
The header of `brokers/checklists.yaml` (lines 5-12) sets rules in comments that no test enforces: public fields (title, why, steps, tips, how_to_undo) contain no research caveats; every `partial` entry explains itself in `notes`; costs are stated. In-house will add entries for 0.4 (the lock-down and check-up lists), so guard the rules now. Tests only: read the bundled file through `checklists.load()` and check each entry. Violations in existing data are findings (strict xfail per entry id, with the entry id and field named) because `brokers/` data is in-house.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. No public field of any entry contains "unconfirmed", "TODO", "TBD", "not sure", "verify this", "citation needed" (case-insensitive).
2. Every entry with `verification == "partial"` has non-empty `notes` (research detail) and each `official_page` entry has at least one `source_urls`.
3. `cost` and `time_needed` are non-empty; `cost` starts with "Free" or contains a currency sign or the word "fee".
4. `how_to_undo` has at least 20 characters (a person can reverse the step) and `steps` has between 1 and 12 items, each under 300 characters.
5. Every `url` and `source_urls` item is `https`; none has credentials or a fragment-only path; every host is lower-case.
6. Reading ease: the average sentence length over `why` and `steps` of each entry is 22 words or fewer (the test prints the worst three ids).
7. No public field contains "guarantee", "erase", "100%" (POSITIONING).
8. `date_checked` is not after the file's `updated` date and not in the future.
9. Failures name the entry id and field, so in-house can fix the data in one pass; the test adds no data files.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
